claims: Continue continuous cardiopulmonary monitoring (telemetry/SpO2) with current alarm limits, given tachycardia, tachypnea, and SpO2 92-97% on supplemental oxygen.
Assess and manage leukocytosis (WBC 19 K/uL) with clinical evaluation for infection and, if indicated, cultures and antimicrobial therapy.
Perform a focused respiratory assessment and consider adjusting supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 above the 92% low alarm limit.
Reassess pain and administer analgesia as needed, given moderate pain scores.
Provide venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin 5000 units, as ordered, unless contraindicated.
Maintain fall precautions and mobility assistance given weak gait/transferring and bed rest status.
Continue monitoring vital signs per ICU protocol, with attention to heart rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and temperature.
Repeat basic metabolic panel and complete blood count within 24 hours to trend electrolytes, renal function, and leukocytosis.
Maintain nothing-by-mouth status pending further evaluation, with intravenous fluid maintenance as ordered.
Continue ondansetron as needed for nausea, with reassessment of symptoms.
